title: Review: post-KITH-3ac8 full codebase
notes:
Maintainer risk: HIGH — three separate P1 correctness bugs (SSRF gap in outbox delivery path, chatId conflict permanent-serverFail loop, queryChanges wrong positions for long chats), two of which are security-adjacent. Distinct from prior review cycles.
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: Message/queryChanges index calculation not fully traced, outbox retry state machine not exhaustively modeled, web client JS not reviewed. Would raise confidence if: integration tests cover chats with >200 messages and queryChanges after a gap, and outbox retry is tested with a DB error injected during complete_delivery.
Maintainer risk: HIGH — two P0 web client bugs (Contact/* method names wrong, chat.participants field doesn't exist) mean the web client is non-functional for contacts and chat naming. These were missed in all prior review cycles.
